task: T13 on-the-fly multistate PySCF and spin-boson HEOM

hardware.timing_context: shared virtual machine with concurrent validation workloads

full_regression.summary: 1 failed, 8231 passed, 218 skipped, 51 warnings, 486 subtests passed in 2405.90s (0:40:05)
full_regression.interpretation: The full suite is not green. Its only failure is the existing CPU-limit signal-order test, which passed independently in both the current branch and the clean base worktree.

limitations: PySCF: real all-electron equal-weight singlet SA-CASSCF only; full NAC, no ETF, SOC, TDDFT, ECP or GPU.
Distinct molecular geometries are solved serially; exact-geometry caching does not eliminate genuine electronic-structure work.
QC electronic context snapshots and full HEOM ADO continuation are available; no new complete trajectory checkpoint I/O or CLI schema.
HEOM: static real two-state Hamiltonian, one finite-temperature Drude-Lorentz bath, factorized free-thermal preparation or a complete existing ADO state.
Finite hierarchy and finite Matsubara truncation require observable-specific convergence; no automatic physical-convergence claim.
The short LiH example has one bead and no realized hop; it does not establish converged photochemical branching.

readme_handoff.en: On-the-fly PySCF SA-CASSCF provides analytic multistate gradients/NACs and phase-consistent many-electron overlaps; a NumPy/SciPy Drude-Lorentz spin-boson HEOM reference adds independent benchmarks and explicit hierarchy/Matsubara convergence scans.
